title: Nonlinear BUN–creatinine imbalance does not establish added anemia prediction in a separate NHANES sample
abstract: In 5,546 NHANES 2009–10 complete-case adults, adding a log(BUN/creatinine) spline to flexible renal, nutritional and demographic predictors gave a weighted Brier gain of 0.00003060 (conditional-source 95% PSU-bootstrap interval -0.00019606 to 0.00025881); added value was not established. Models were fitted in 5,168 NHANES 2007–08 adults and frozen before evaluation in a separate 2009–10 sample. The ratio supplies nonlinear structure, not information absent from its components. Subgroup gains changed sign; no biomarker novelty, causal mechanism, equivalence or clinical utility is established.
